premise: Leo ordered a hundred seeds and the supply pod opens full of socks — until he finds the seeds tucked safely inside every one.
inspiration: Grimm's 'The Three Feathers', where the plainest-looking choice holds the treasure, turned: the plain gift is socks, and the treasure is tucked inside.
lesson: Look inside before you give up on a gift.

en-US.title: Socks, Not Seeds
en-US.text: {man:enter} Leo had ordered one hundred seeds from Earth. Tomatoes! Beans! Sunflowers! {man:face happy} {sfx:thud} Down came the {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} supply pod onto the landing pad. Along rolled the {buggy:enter} buggy {buggy:go to supply-pod} to carry the cargo home. {supply-pod:live} The pod's side panels slid open. Leo opened the first crate and {man:face surprised} stared. Socks. A whole crate of socks! {man:says} [nervously] “Socks? I asked for seeds!” {man:shake 0.4} He opened the next crate. More socks. {buggy:wobble} And the next. Socks, socks, socks. {man:face sad} [sighs] Leo sat down on a crate. {man:live hold} He checked the order list on his wrist. At the very bottom was a note. [curious] Seeds packed inside socks, so they travel safely. Love, Earth. {man:live resume} [laughs] Leo shook a sock. Out tumbled a packet of seeds! {man:face happy} {man:says} [happily] “Ninety-nine socks to go!” {man:hop x2} {buggy:live}

es-ES.title: Calcetines, no semillas
es-ES.text: {man:enter} Leo había pedido cien semillas a la Tierra. ¡Tomates! ¡Judías! ¡Girasoles! {man:face happy} {sfx:thud} Y bajó la {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} cápsula de carga hasta la plataforma de aterrizaje. Llegó rodando el {buggy:enter} buggy {buggy:go to supply-pod} para llevar la carga a casa. {supply-pod:live} Los paneles laterales se abrieron. Leo abrió la primera caja y {man:face surprised} se quedó mirando. Calcetines. ¡Una caja entera de calcetines! {man:says} [nervously] «¿Calcetines? ¡Yo pedí semillas!» {man:shake 0.4} Abrió la siguiente caja. Más calcetines. {buggy:wobble} Y la siguiente. Calcetines, calcetines, calcetines. {man:face sad} [sighs] Leo se sentó en una caja. {man:live hold} Miró la lista del pedido en su muñeca. Al final del todo había una nota. [curious] Semillas guardadas dentro de calcetines, para que viajen seguras. Con cariño, la Tierra. {man:live resume} [laughs] Leo sacudió un calcetín. ¡Y cayó un sobre de semillas! {man:face happy} {man:says} [happily] «¡Quedan noventa y nueve calcetines!» {man:hop x2} {buggy:live}

thud.prompt: a soft, deep, muffled thud felt through the ground, as if heard through thick boots
